subject: Findings should remain traceable to their sources, with corrections retained.
rationale: Source traceability and retained corrections faithfully transfer the mechanism of preserving an inspectable documentary history to inquiry findings. They enable review of evidential origins and revisions, relevant to assessing explanations for the repeat-purchase decline. This licenses the proposed provenance operation; it does not establish successful implementation, truthful sources, or any explanation of nonpurchase. An unspecified retention mechanism does not defeat this narrowly scoped proposal.
